prop_statement: :class:`.TemplateLookup` documents that a URI is "appended to each directory and the filesystem checked", and :class:`.Template` explicitly rejects a uri that "cannot be relative outside of the root path". So: whatever uri is handed to ``get_template``, the template that comes back must live inside one of the lookup directories.
``has_template`` is documented to return True iff the lookup is "capable of returning a Template object for the given uri".
The runtime (<%include>/<%namespace>) path: adjust_uri then get_template.
If filename_to_uri returns a uri for a filename, then joining that uri back onto the lookup directory must give the original filename.
